_doc: Per-cell corrections + accept-list for shp_history.json. Applied by fetch_shareholding.py
(apply_cell_fix) on every run, AFTER the fetch loop — never edit shp_history.json directly
(CLAUDE.md rule 5, runbook §22g). Idempotent; re-running a backfill cannot re-poison a fixed cell.
fix.<SYM>.<QE> = the ordinary-equity pattern, replacing a filing that describes something else.
cell = [prom, fii, dii, mf, ins, sub-date, nsh]  (same shape as shp_history)
src  = system:document that the corrected numbers were parsed from
was  = the wrong cell being replaced, kept so the override is auditable and self-checking:
if the stored cell no longer matches `was`, apply_cell_fix warns instead of silently
accept.<SYM>.<QE> = a shareholder-count collapse that is REAL (post-insolvency capital
reduction, pre-IPO pattern, ...). Exempts the cell from the write-time nsh scale gate so a
--reparse cannot punch a hole in correct data. See runbook §22g for how each was adjudicated.
_doc_bulk_stamp: 2026-08-13: 441 rows across 57 symbols carried ONE identical submission date across >=3 quarters — a scrape date, not a filing date. Separated from the 268 symbols whose late dates are DISTINCT per quarter (genuinely late filers: TALWALKARS, MANPASAND et al) — those are left alone, because for a distressed company a multi-year filing lag is real. The discriminator is the identical-date collapse, and the fii/dii values under it differ per quarter, which is what proves the data was read per-quarter and only the date was stamped.

DSKULKARNI.2023-09-30: Post-insolvency capital reduction: prom steps 46.84 -> 95.00 and STAYS there through 2026-06-30, including later filings with a normal holder count (4,582). The holdings are corroborated; only the nsh=8 is doubtful and it has NOT been verified against BSE.

FEDDERELEC.2021-12-31: prom 100.00 / 7 holders persists across every filing from 2021-12 to 2025-03 and never recovers — consistent with a post-insolvency reduction rather than a one-off wrong document. NOT verified against BSE (symbol absent from bse_scrips by_id).

JPINFRATEC.2024-06-30: Post-resolution (Suraksha): existing equity extinguished, company wholly owned by the resolution applicant. prom 100.00 / 1 holder is the real pattern, not a stub — it persists in every later filing.

Corrected only because the stamp signature is present as well — the date is shared with another quarter of the same symbol, or the lag exceeds a year. Rows 120-365d late carrying a LONE date are left alone: there a single genuinely-delayed filing cannot be told from a stamp.
